svg.title: 02 — Fail-closed classification and HL7
svg.desc: TARGET WORKFLOW • new type / human-release / HL7 stages are DESIGN ONLY • pending review or transform failure is NOT completion. All service icons are unmodified embedded official Microsoft Azure SVGs.

text.tspan: TARGET WORKFLOW • new type / human-release / HL7 stages are DESIGN ONLY • pending review or transform failure is NOT completion
READ LEFT → RIGHT, THEN FOLLOW ARROWS • both approval paths share the transformation and publication gates
Queue contains faxId only; load trusted source
Preserve original bytes and page mapping
Check media, size, page and parser limits
Every page assigned once; confidence gated
This is NOT the fax-type decision
Empty body or ambiguous split → review
Cover removal is not malware scanning
Exam record / order / Rx / approved others
Classify logical fax using body evidence
Analyze body bytes, not the cover
Use extractor selected by confirmed fax type
Required fields, nested items and page map
Type selects downstream HL7 mapping policy
ALL expected fields present and valid
Minimum score, never average or round up
Type / business validation must also pass
Preserve original scores and type evidence
No accepted output or release manifest
Classification, field or input failures enter here
Confirm fax type, body pages and all fields
Correct values; retain original machine scores
Re-extract with confirmed type if needed
Record reviewer identity, time and evidence
No approval until required data is resolved
Validate corrected values and required fields
Do NOT raise machine scores to simulate 80%
Still NOT complete; transformation must run
Canonical fields, source and confirmed fax type
Evaluate ALL source / content / type routes
Freeze output plan + mapping / profile versions
Per destination + fax type + selected data
YES: every required HL7 output must validate
Missing mapping is an ERROR, not a NO
Same decision for auto and human approval
Persist the reason in the publication manifest
No silent skip for unsupported required data
JSON / all other required outputs still apply
Function activity; versioned mapping per route
Map IDs, codes, units, timestamps and repeats
NO invented / silently truncated clinical values
Validate every message, not just the first
All pass → publish; ANY fail → hold
Retain draft, mapping version and safe reasons
No successful completion or release manifest
Mapping defects need an approved code fix
Never approve around failed HL7 validation
Human review is an approval path, not a bypass
All approved data + HL7 + routes must persist
Consumers use only a completed manifest
Population accuracy is evaluated on page 3
Not consumable until manifest is committed
Require every planned write + hash check
Partial writes → retry / hold, NOT complete
No-match routes: primary is still required
Required HL7 validated OR explicit N/A
Record hashes, models, mappings and approval
If delivery added: track ACK / NACK separately
Receiver profile and HL7 version need approval
Train page classifier, fax-type classifier and extractors
Evaluate by type/source; promote immutable model IDs
Receiver agrees message version, profile and field mappings
Clinical owner approves codes, units and identity matching
Review service requires RBAC, immutable audit and concurrency
Both paths must pass the same transformation checks
Existing app has page-derived type + 80% gate + JSON routes.
Dedicated type step, human release and HL7 are not coded.
Do not deploy this diagram as proof of those features.
Dashed red: invalid / uncertain / unknown / mixed → review
No cross-blob transaction. Manifest-last is the release barrier; neither saved review evidence nor a generated HL7 draft means Completed.
Proposed target workflow, not a measured accuracy or clinical-safety claim. A failed required check always blocks completion.
